$description: Tokens only the phone and watch apps use. They are not written to the web's CSS.

standard.$description: Default spring for sheets, navigation and anything that moves. The native match for ease-standard at duration-slow.

bouncy.$description: Playful moments only: the fairness needle landing at 50/50, a goal ticking up. The native match for ease-bounce.

goal.$description: A goal is logged, on the phone tracker and the watch.

select.$description: A player is picked for a swap, the scorer wheel moves a slice.

lock.$description: Teams are locked, a match is ended.
